turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got a pile of luggage and I need to get from the airport into the old town.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait until I've gone through all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The airport express train is quick, but from the central station it's a twenty minute walk over cobbles.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A shuttle bus goes right to the old town square, though it only runs every forty minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Taxis are waiting outside, but the driver who brought my friend charged a ridiculous amount.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a tram, cheap and frequent, but the carriages are small and usually crowded.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Check when the next shuttle leaves. If it's soon, take it. If it's a long wait, a taxi from the official rank is worth it, just agree the price before you set off.
